Specification: This module is a thin wrapper around another specification, CRDT, and exists primarily to add Apalache-specific type annotations while keeping the original CRDT module unchanged. It declares a constant set of nodes and a variable counter with an annotated function type from nodes to nodes to integers, and it provides a concrete set of node values for use by configuration. The module itself does not define an algorithm, transition relation, temporal specification, or fault model; instead, it instantiates the external CRDT module without substitutions and adds only local declarations and a helper constant definition.
